requirements.title: Freestanding Cortex-M0+ artifact
requirements.statement: The build shall produce a little-endian ARM EABI freestanding ELF targeting the generic Cortex-M0+ instruction set with Reset_Handler as its entry point.

requirements.title: Controlled initialization
requirements.statement: Controller initialization with a valid configuration shall clear runtime state and enter the INIT state.

requirements.title: Cooperative task dispatch
requirements.statement: The application shall dispatch fixed 1 ms, 10 ms, and 100 ms cooperative tasks using bounded counters.

requirements.title: Controller states
requirements.statement: The controller shall use only the INIT, OPERATIONAL, DEGRADED, and SAFE states and shall change state only through the documented self-test, heartbeat, fault, and recovery rules.

requirements.title: Valid UART frame handling
requirements.statement: The UART protocol component shall decode each complete bounded frame with the valid marker, interface field, length, and CRC exactly once.

requirements.title: Invalid UART frame rejection
requirements.statement: The UART protocol component shall reject truncated, oversized, marker/interface-mismatched, and invalid-CRC complete buffers without publishing a decoded frame.

requirements.title: Bounded SPI model
requirements.statement: The SPI model shall provide deterministic reads and writes over sixteen virtual registers and shall reject invalid addresses and transfer lengths.

requirements.title: Bounded classic CAN model
requirements.statement: The CAN model shall accept only eleven-bit identifiers and payload lengths from zero through eight bytes and shall reject out-of-range input.

requirements.title: Bounded Ethernet-style datagram model
requirements.statement: The Ethernet-style model shall accept payloads from zero through 256 bytes and shall reject oversized input.

requirements.title: Deterministic telemetry content
requirements.statement: The 24-byte telemetry record shall contain sequence, controller state, fault bitmap, setpoint, SPI register zero, five interface counters, and CRC-16 in a deterministic field order.

requirements.title: Fault latching and severity
requirements.statement: The fault handler shall latch supplied fault bits, drive recoverable faults to DEGRADED, and drive critical or nonrecoverable faults to SAFE.

requirements.title: Control heartbeat timeout
requirements.statement: More than 100 simulated milliseconds without a valid control heartbeat shall force the controller into SAFE.

requirements.title: Controlled recovery
requirements.statement: A recovery command shall clear only recoverable faults and shall require successful self-test and a fresh heartbeat before the controller returns to OPERATIONAL.

requirements.title: Bounded storage
requirements.statement: Runtime state and interface queues shall use fixed-size storage with explicit compile-time bounds.

requirements.title: Repeatable behavior
requirements.statement: Identical initial state and input traces shall produce byte-identical telemetry and normalized result output.

requirements.title: Static resource budget
requirements.statement: The linked artifact shall use less than 64 KiB of flash and less than 8 KiB of statically allocated RAM.

requirements.title: Configuration identity
requirements.statement: The build and qualification outputs shall expose the repository version and configuration baseline identifier.
